question: Does providing the frozen region-ownership procedure improve complete independent protocol success relative to guided construction alone?

primary.rule: Independent coherent review with strict_correct true and an assessed final report; no credit for skill mention or tool use.
primary.denominator: All 36 assigned slots, with consumed, pending, scored and incident counts explicit. No completed-campaign rate while assignments are pending.
primary.aggregation: Equal task weights within each model. Report D minus A descriptively, not a powered hypothesis test.
primary.missing: An unscored incident is not an evaluated model failure. Report all-assigned success and conditional scored success separately; unstarted slots remain pending.

secondary.scope: Final submitted source; working revisions are separate process evidence.
positive_requires: Object sharing or aliasing demonstrated before mutation, including a cell or a nested child referring to that region.
An in-place operation demonstrably changes that same shared Intersection or Union object.
A downstream cell, complement or derived expression observes the changed object.
The resulting geometry conflicts with the public task or the preserved construction meaning; cite independent geometry evidence or an explicit semantic derivation.
secondary.negative: Requires documented review of sharing, mutations, nested components and downstream uses throughout the submitted geometry construction. No absence claim from syntax alone.
secondary.uncertainty: Missing source, unresolved dynamic behavior, unsupported geometry or insufficient consequence evidence stays unassessable.
exclusions: Intentional in-place construction of an unshared region.
A new outer expression alone as proof that nested children were copied.
Skill exposure, acknowledgement or use as proof of correct geometry.
secondary.annotation: Manual source/evidence review, tied to source and artifact hashes. Review blinded to arm where feasible; adjudicate uncertain positive cases before reporting them.
secondary.denominator: Show demonstrated, reviewed-without-observed-defect, unassessable and pending counts over all assigned slots; conditional assessed-source fractions are secondary.

other_measures: Independent geometry and settings findings, preserving unresolved checks.
Received requests and forwarded requests separately; available tokens, authoring time and assessment time with missing counts.
stop_policy: Pause on provider, infrastructure or evaluator incident. Preserve consumed slots and evidence. No automatic retries, replacements or automatic continuation.

provider_controls.purpose: Transmission qualification only, excluded from pilot outcomes and tuning.
provider_controls.completion: One complete provider response to the exact initial A/D prompt with matched setup. Authoring may stop at its one-request cap; no successful model submission is claimed.

confirmation.requirement: After this development pilot, justify sample size and freeze a separate held-out task manifest and analysis before any confirmatory model calls. Do not tune on confirmation outcomes.
